svg.aria-label: the right way to say thank you

text.tspan: the right way to say thank you
rationale
the „i voted" sticker is the most ordinary symbol of
election day: familiar, expected and often
forgotten within hours. „the right way to say thank
you" gives this everyday piece of voting culture a
new meaning. the print series shows two
emblematic landmarks in the broader history of
voting rights — susan b. anthony's grave and the
selma to montgomery national historic trail —
covered with stickers from voters today. these sites
represent defining struggles led by women and
black americans while standing for the many
people and movements that expanded access to
the ballot. by placing a routine contemporary
symbol at sites of historic significance, the
campaign connects today's visual culture of
participation with the sacrifices behind it. it turns a
disposable badge into a lasting tribute: the most
meaningful way to thank those who fought for
your right to vote is to use it.
